description: General machinery drive ACS355 over the embedded fieldbus (Modbus RTU, EIA-485 through the FMBA-01 module or RS-232 through the panel connector)
source: ABB, "ACS355 drives user's manual", 3AUA0000066143 revision E; https://library.e.abb.com/public/805f31a82d524d8aa8a750011e2cd001/EN_ACS355_UM_E_A5.pdf

sources.title: ACS355 drives user's manual
sources.note: chapter 13 (embedded fieldbus) and the actual signals and parameters of groups 01, 03, 04, 16, 30, 52, 53 and 98

notes: Register 4xxxx is sent as address xxxx - 1, so this map uses address_base 1: 40001 control word is address 1, parameter 0104 is address 104. Parameters 0101 to 9999 sit at registers 40101 to 49999.
Communication works only after 9802 COMM PROT SEL is set to standard Modbus and the group 53 parameters are set; new settings take effect at the next power-up.

Control word and status word are available in two forms: the 16-bit ABB drives profile (registers 1 and 4) and the 32-bit DCU profile (registers 31 to 34); which one works depends on 5305 EFB CTRL PROFILE.
To control the drive from the network set the command and reference sources (1001, 1002, 1102, 1103, 1106) to COMM.
Parameter writes over Modbus are volatile; write 1 to 1607 PARAM SAVE to keep them.

This map holds the control area, the operating data and fault groups, and the serial-link parameters. The other drive parameters follow the same rule (parameter number is the register) and are in the manual's parameter list.
Signed values use two's complement. Supported functions are 3, 6, 8 (diagnostics), 16 and 23.
The factory serial settings are station ID 1, 9.6 kbit/s, 8 data bits, no parity and 1 stop bit.
